aboutTitle: A Church Built on Love, Hope & Faith
aboutBody: Grace Baptist Church Nairobi has been a beacon of hope in our community since 2000. We are a diverse, Spirit-led congregation committed to the timeless truth of God's Word and the transforming power of His love.
aboutBody2: Our doors are open to everyone — regardless of background, season of life, or story. Come discover a community that walks together through every chapter of life.
verseText: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
